caption:
You think you have to earn it first. You're sure acceptance comes only after you prove yourself — but what if the promise arrived long before the demand? (Galatians 3:17 devotional)

The law came 430 years after the promise and couldn't annul it — because God counted Abraham righteous by faith long before any rule was given. Justification is received, not achieved; He credits His own righteousness to you the moment you believe. The very order of the story — promise first, law second — is itself grace.
